model: Asset-Level Five-Lens Probability-Adjusted Economic Valuation Model

definitions.replacementCost: Existing recreation/replacement-cost baseline for comparable current work product.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Modelled marketability indication using maturity, commercial-potential and sector factors. It is not a verified comparable-transactions valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Modelled monetization indication using maturity, commercial-potential and route-to-market factors. It is not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation because asset-specific revenue forecasts and royalty benchmarks are not established.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Replacement-cost anchored opportunity value adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, a rights/transfer diligence reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Weighted preliminary seller-side economic reference combining the four valuation lenses above. It is not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Existing seller-side asking reference, deliberately separate from economic-reference modelling.
